clues: One of the most far north towns on Earth, it is the main town of an Arctic island group. Its shore looks out on cold northern seas.
Here the sun shines at midnight through much of the warm months. Then deep night holds sway for more than three months of winter.
This town began in 1906, when a coal firm from America started to mine coal here. Coal was the whole reason the town was built at all.
In 1943, a wartime navy force wrecked nearly the whole of this town. Yet once the war had ended, folk built it up once more.
Here stands a global seed vault, a famed draw for guests and scholars. They come from far lands to work and learn in the cold.
